root_idea.summary: An orderly bringing of one thing together with another, whether stacked upright or arranged side by side.
root_idea.development: The core idea develops from arranging goods into piles or ordered groupings to compactly arranged natural growth and layered formations. Figurative extensions include assembled groups and supporters, eminence, and related objects used to hold or cushion piled goods.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized passive-participial citation form مَنْضُود.
Displayed as the distinct Quran-attested adjective نَضِيد.

senses.definition: Placed one upon another; piled or layered in an orderly, compact arrangement.
senses.usage_conditions: A passive-participial adjective for things set in successive layers or placed compactly together. The Quran applies it to the layered stones of 11:82 and to the compactly arranged طَلْح in 56:29.

senses.definition: Closely set or piled one upon another; compactly arranged in ordered layers.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression طَلْعٌ نَضِيدٌ, it describes palm spadices or fruit compactly disposed. The supplied lexical discussion also applies the same constructional meaning to vegetation whose fruit or leaves are closely set.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To place goods, household goods, or commodities one upon another or together in regular order; to pile them up.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction also describes placing crude bricks in an orderly arrangement against a corpse as a support.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause a person's teeth to be disposed in regular order.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative Form II construction specifically attested with the teeth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the teeth to become disposed in regular order.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive or middle Form V construction used of the teeth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be put or set one part upon or beside another in regular order; to become piled up.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A quasi-passive Form VIII construction describing an arrangement coming about or being established.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a people to remain, stay, or dwell in a place and gather there.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form VIII usage applied to a people who collect and settle in one place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Goods, household goods, or commodities arranged or piled together; by extension, such goods generally or the best of them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The primary nominal sense concerns goods placed one upon another or set together in regular order.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A couch-frame or raised couch on which goods are placed; also, a rack-like stand for garments and household goods.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is named in relation to the goods arranged upon it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Glory, honor, dignity, eminence, might, or power.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative nominal extension from elevation and assembled distinction.
An adjectival use applied to a man.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man's paternal and maternal uncles who are preeminent in nobility.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative kinship usage emphasizing distinguished relatives.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A party, company, assembled body, number, or group of auxiliaries and supporters belonging to a people or a man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural may denote congregated companies of men as well as the strength or assistance supplied by them.
A figurative comparison with a raised couch or frame bearing piled goods.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Stones of mountains piled one upon another, or portions of cloud piled above one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural usage for natural masses characterized by superposition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pillow or any stuffed article of household furniture; also a collective term for such stuffed furnishings.
Arranged or put together in regular order, as pearls arranged in a row or set.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive Form II participle used in the expression دُرٌّ مُنَضَّدٌ.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Specific brick-setting construction covered by the Form I arranging sense.
Illustrative example adding no new lexical branch.
Pointer-only cross-reference to نَضَدٌ and نَضِيدٌ.
Parallel description of leaves and fruit set one above another.

cautions: Lane's historical Quran citation notation is retained only as lexical evidence; it is not converted into additional modern Quran locations beyond the QAC-supplied occurrences.
